ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:15 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity black field with a singular, high-contrast white irregular patch localized at the median notch vertex; scattered high-intensity white pixels concentrated at the distal lobe tips (apexes).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an estimated interior angle of 35 degrees; depth extends approximately 12% of the visible vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations (peaks/valleys) along the entire trailing edge; amplitude of variations is most pronounced on the inner margins of the left and right lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave curve originating from the median notch, sweeping upward and outward toward sharp, distinct distal apexes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of circular, high-contrast white pixels (barnacle colonization) localized on the trailing edge of both the far-left and far-right lobe tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Fine, low-density vertical white linear streaks visible on the central-right quadrant and near the lower-central notch area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive focal scarring and calcified accretions at both lobe apexes; several small, circular white punctures/scars distributed sparsely across the lower-right fluke surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of brownish-gold organic filamentous material (algal growth or debris) entangled with the barnacle clusters at the extreme distal tips of both lobes.
